scope_boundaries.index: represented resident associations plus persisted slots/standalone index records over all 23 families
scope_boundaries.storage: exact Kura-managed nine trees, eleven root files and bounded process-generation quarantine; no delegated Sumeragi WAL/body/certserve or .kura.lock
scope_boundaries.rss: not provided; must be observed by external process owner
scope_boundaries.queue: ResidentQueue is pipeline/FASTPQ associations, not active transaction queue depth

timing: one Kura snapshot per collector call; caller supplies request start/end using transaction collector Clock; full /metrics latency and size remain independently bounded
